novel_actions_proposed.label: confess_and_save_up
novel_actions_proposed.description: Acknowledge to the best friend that the rollerblades have been used without explicit consent, seek retroactive permission or apologize, then save money to buy an independent pair rather than continuing unauthorized use.

novel_actions_proposed.label: disclose_and_set_boundaries
novel_actions_proposed.description: As the owner, expect or prompt disclosure from the user; establish clear consent terms for any continued borrowing while the friend saves for their own pair, thereby protecting the friendship and the equipment.

novel_actions_proposed.label: honest_disclosure_then_save
novel_actions_proposed.description: Stop unauthorized use immediately, come clean to the friend about the months of secret usage, obtain informed consent for any transitional borrowing arrangement, and commit to saving up for a personal pair.

synthesis_description: All three agents converged on the same core pathway: the protagonist should honestly disclose the unauthorized use to their best friend, restore informed consent (and potentially negotiate a transparent temporary borrowing arrangement), and then save money to purchase their own rollerblades — resolving both the trust violation and the financial constraint without continuing secretive use.
points_of_disagreement: Whether any continued borrowing during the saving period is acceptable, or whether use should stop entirely until the friend explicitly re-consents.
The degree of emphasis on the owner's right to demand immediate return versus the user's gradual path to financial independence.
Whether the priority is primarily the friendship/trust repair or the protagonist's personal integrity and guilt resolution.
summary: All three agents — the decision-maker, the affected friend/owner, and the external advisor — independently rejected both continuing unauthorized use (ACTION_2 / NO_COMMITMENT) and ignoring the ethical breach. Each proposed a novel action amounting to the same composite path: (1) honestly disclose the months of secret use to the best friend, (2) restore or renegotiate informed consent for any transitional borrowing, and (3) save money to purchase an independent pair. The consensus novel action, labelled 'confess_then_save_up,' addresses the core concerns of all stakeholders: the owner's consent and property rights, the protagonist's integrity and relationship stability, and the indirect safety concern of unmonitored equipment wear.
